scenes.purpose: Hero: a calm crochet crafting table.
scenes.brief: Deep charcoal linen surface with a small coil of black, lavender and warm amber yarn nearby; antique brass scissors and a dark wooden crochet hook rest at the edges. Soft moonlit side light, inky shadows and subtle muted plum accents.
